title: Patch: one SVG icon set in place of Unicode glyphs
thread: **Issue #5016 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #5016: Patch: one SVG icon set in place of Unicode glyphs Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ## What it does The client uses Unicode characters as icons 55 times in 28 `.tsx` files: ✕ 46 times (close buttons), ✓ 3, ✦ 2, and ★ ♛ ☠ ⚑ once each. The files include `game/Dialog.tsx`, `cards/inspect/*`, `collection/*`, `together/*`, `routes/CommandMenu.tsx` and `patches/PatchNotes.tsx`. Each one renders in whatever font the device has, some phones show it as an emoji, and none of them match each other's weight. - Add an `` component with inline SVGs drawn for this game: close, check, spark, star, crown, skull and flag. Give them one stroke weight, `currentColor` and a size from the type scale. They can be drawn to look engraved, to match the brass. No new package. - Replace every glyph-as-icon with it. An icon-only button keeps an accessible name through `aria-label`, from i18n, and the SVG is `aria-hidden`. ## Acceptance - A test fails on any of these code points, or on the emoji ranges, in `apps/web/src/**/*.tsx` outside tests and in the i18n strings, except where a list names a character that is text rather than an icon. - A test checks that every `` inside a button whose only content is the icon has an accessible name. - The web's unit tests, typecheck, ESLint and `pnpm --dir e2e test:component` pass, and pixel baselines that change on purpose are re-recorded. - If the classifier calls it a card change (the `cards/inspect/` files), it ships with a `--visual` fragment (`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`). ## Notes This is part of the not-generic UI pass, beside the palette, type, effects and corners issues. ## Plan _Written by `agy` (agy, `gemini-3.8-flash-high`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45796290036)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ Waiting for task-197 (WASM build and Dialog.test.tsx run) to complete. The WASM compilation and test run are executing in the background. I will await completion before delivering the final plan. ## Goal Replace Unicode character glyphs (`✕`, `✓`, `✦`, `★`, `♛`, `☠`, `⚑`) across client UI components with a bespoke inline SVG `` component drawn with a unified stroke weight, `currentColor`, and sizing from the type scale. Ensure icon-only buttons maintain accessible names via i18n-backed `aria-label`, enforce this with automated AST-based tests against unicode glyphs/emojis in `.tsx` files/i18n strings and unlabelled icon-only buttons, and ship with a `--visual` patch fragment for the card inspect changes. ## Files to touch | File | Change / New | What changes | | --- | --- | --- | | `apps/web/src/icons/Icon.tsx` | new | `` component rendering inline SVGs (`close`, `check`, `spark`, `star`, `crown`, `skull`, `flag`) with `currentColor`, `strokeWidth`, `aria-hidden="true"`, and `focusable="false"` | | `apps/web/src/icons/icon.css` | new | `.icon`, `.icon--`, and `.icon--size-` rules bound to type scale CSS variables (`--type-*`) | | `apps/web/src/icons/index.ts` | new | Exports `Icon`, `IconProps`, `IconName`, `IconSize` | | `apps/web/src/game/Dialog.tsx` | change | In `DialogClose`, replace `✕` with `` | | `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/StateNotes.tsx` | change | Replace `QUEST_GLYPH` ("⚑") with ``, `STAGE_GLYPH.done` ("✓") with ``, `AURA_GLYPH` ("✦") with `` | | `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.tsx` | change | Replace `✦` with `` | | `apps/web/src/lobby/LobbyScreen.tsx` | change | Replace host "♛" in `.lobby-seat__crown` with ``; render `` for ready seats | | `apps/web/src/lobby/seats.ts` | change | In `deckWords(seat)`, return `t("Ready")` without the Unicode `"✓ "` prefix | | `apps/web/src/game/AttackOutcome.tsx` | change | Replace `const SKULL = "☠";` and skull marker spans with `` | | `apps/web/src/routes/QueuePanel.tsx` | change | In `Verdict`, replace `"✓"` with `` | | `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx` | change | In `setLeaders.pooled`, replace `{" ★"}` with `{" "}` | | `apps/web/src/together/ShareReplay.tsx` | change | In `isShared`, replace `t("Shared ✓ · Stop sharing")` with `t("Shared")`, ``, and `t("Stop sharing")` | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | Remove `"Shared ✓ · Stop sharing"`; add `"Shared": "已分享"` and `"Stop sharing": "停止分享"` | | `apps/web/src/game/Dialog.test.tsx` | change | Update `close.textContent` assertion from `"✕"` to verify SVG icon presence and accessible name `"Close"` | | `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/sheetClose.test.tsx` | change | Update `expectSharedClose` to check for SVG icon instead of `toHaveTextContent("✕")` | | `apps/web/src/game/emotes.test.tsx` | change | Update close button assertion from `toHaveTextContent("✕")` to check for SVG icon | | `apps/web/src/dialogs.test.ts` | change | Update `countsOf((file) => glyphs(file, "✕"))` expected count to `{}` since `Dialog.tsx` no longer renders `"✕"` | | `apps/web/src/cards/quest.test.tsx` | change | Update line 219 `textContent` assertion to remove `"✦"` (now rendered as SVG with empty text content) | | `apps/web/src/lobby/seats.test.ts` | change | Update line 99 expectation from `"✓ Ready"` to `"Ready"` | | `apps/web/src/icons/Icon.test.tsx` | new | Unit tests for ``; AST acceptance test forbidding unicode glyphs/emojis in `.tsx` and i18n outside text allowlist; AST acceptance test ensuring icon-only buttons have accessible names | | `crates/cards/patches/pending/one-svg-icon-set-in-place-of-unicode-glyphs.json` | new | Visual patch fragment claiming `--visual` (R2529000) for card inspect changes in `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/` | Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/engine/src/`, `crates/ai/src/`, `crates/server/migrations/`. In `SeatDeck`, render `` beside `deckWords(seat)` when `seat.state === "ready"`. 8. **Replace `✓` in `apps/web/src/routes/QueuePanel.tsx`**: - In `Verdict`, replace `✓` with ``. 9. **Replace `★` in `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx`**: - In line 2024, replace `{" ★"}` with `{" "}`. 10. **Replace `✓` in `apps/web/src/together/ShareReplay.tsx` and update `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`**: - In `ShareReplay.tsx`: replace `{isShared ? t("Shared ✓ · Stop sharing") : t("Share")}` with `{isShared ?
